commonDirection: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: canonical individual bestiary production concept master for later 3D design. Create exactly one complete original Salt-Waste Pilgrims subject in a polished stylized 3D dark-fantasy MMORPG production style, three-quarter view, centered with generous clearance. Family identity is mirror salt: salt-white crust and powder, mirror-blue reflective surfaces, restrained sunless-gold framing and hardware, mature wind-bent robe or burrower construction where canon requires it. Every load-bearing element and form-specific mechanic cue must remain mechanically plausible and measurable. Flat near-black neutral opaque studio backdrop; cold raking light from one side; ungraded neutral presentation. assets.name: Salt-Veil Strider

canonical.anatomy: A pilgrim crusted to its robes after walking through a storm that scoured away direction. The missing anatomy briefly outlines itself when its robe spreads into a perfectly level line.
canonical.locomotion: It crosses ground in one committed weight transfer, then must reassemble its balance; the permission cue is its robe spreads into a perfectly level line.
canonical.sound: mirror salt produces a load-bearing groan, one blunt beat, and a long settling scrape; White Horizon commits on the first frost/blind sound after the gap.
canonical.purpose: A future frontier hook: pilgrims cross the eastern salt waste carrying sealed mirrors toward the Reach. This form serves the niche expressed by a pilgrim crusted to its robes after walking through a storm that scoured away direction.
canonical.origin: A pilgrim crusted to its robes after walking through a storm that scoured away direction.
canonical.cue: Its robe spreads into a perfectly level line.
canonical.counterplay: Move close enough that the horizon passes behind you.

assets.masterDirection: Show one mature wind-bent pilgrim almost entirely fused into layered salt-crusted robes, with one sealed oval mirror-blue face and no visible ordinary face or flesh. The robe shell is hollow through the central torso and lower limbs: only a thin salt-white outline of the missing anatomy remains inside the black gaps. At the poised end of one committed weight transfer, the opposing outer robe edges pull outward into exactly one perfectly straight, perfectly level horizontal salt-white line crossing behind the central body from left edge to right edge of the subject silhouette. The line is physically made from the spread robe hem, not a horizon, beam, floor, landscape, or aura; the central body visibly passes in front so the counterplay can move close enough for the line to pass behind. Preserve exactly two complete braced feet, the single level line, full mirror face, hollow robe gaps, and complete framing. No weapon, second line, terrain, skyline, extra pilgrim, text, or readable mark.

canonical.locomotion: It changes lanes after a false retreat and never repeats the same return angle; the permission cue is the shell reflection rushes toward the viewer before the beetle moves.
canonical.sound: mirror salt produces two retreating clicks answered by a third sound from the return angle; Elsewhere Dive commits on the first movement/strike sound after the gap.
canonical.purpose: A future frontier hook: pilgrims cross the eastern salt waste carrying sealed mirrors toward the Reach. This form serves the niche expressed by a salt burrower that carries a mirrored shell reflecting somewhere several miles east.
canonical.origin: A salt burrower that carries a mirrored shell reflecting somewhere several miles east.
canonical.cue: The shell reflection rushes toward the viewer before the beetle moves.
canonical.counterplay: Track the reflected terrain to predict its emergence direction.

assets.masterDirection: Show one low mature salt-burrowing beetle form in a complete lateral three-quarter crawl, with exactly six complete jointed mirror-salt legs and a single large sealed mirror-blue shell framed in restrained sunless gold. Inside that shell only, show one flat optical reflection of the same beetle silhouette rushing sharply toward the viewer before the solid body moves; it is one reflection, never a second creature or body. Contain a few sparse abstract salt-stratum shapes entirely inside the shell reflection so their directional convergence can be tracked to predict emergence, without forming a real landscape or readable map. Pose the solid beetle in the false-retreat transition with one returning lane angle carried by the legs. Keep all six legs, the complete shell, the rushing flat reflection, and the contained reflected strata fully visible. No humanoid, extra beetle, ordinary scenery, ground trail, burrow hole, bright glare, text, or external mirror panel.

assets.masterDirection: Show one mature narrow wind-bent bearer whose head and face are completely replaced by one large mirror-blue plate strapped directly to the front of the hood with taut weathered bands and sunless-gold corner hardware. The mirror has exactly four plain wax corner seals, one at each corner.
